title: Model Triage Pipeline — Inference Vendor Delta Ledger
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Background: As more open and third-party LLM variants appear, product teams need an automated, auditable stream that detects substantive vendor/model changes (perf deltas, API contract drift, pricing shifts, quantization impacts) and surfaces prioritized remediation recommendations. This ticket scopes a Model Triage Pipeline and a 'Delta Ledger' artifact to capture change events, compute impact scores, and drive downstream alerts, field probes, and procurement actions.

Goal: Build an end-to-end pipeline that ingests model metadata + weekly microbenchmarks + telemetry, computes a vendor/model delta score (regression, improvement, compatibility risk), stores immutable ledger entries, and exposes actionable rows in the Console and a lightweight CSV/Slack feed for Sales/SEs.

Deliverables: 1) Delta Ledger schema and ingestion lambda; 2) Scoring function (regression severity, customer exposure, cost delta) with parameterized thresholds; 3) Console table and per-model timeline; 4) Scheduled probe runner (synthetic workloads) and integration to existing watch alerts; 5) Runbook for triage owners and procurement play triggers.

Success metrics: 1) Time-to-detect major regression < 48h for seeded probes; 2) 90% of high-confidence regressions classified with correct remediation (fallback, throttle, pin) in lab; 3) Reduce manual triage time for PM/SEs by 60% in Q2 pilot.

Approach: - Ingest sources: model catalog snapshots, nightly microbenchmarks (latency/cost/quality), embeddings/semantic drift metrics, customer usage telemetry, public vendor notices. - Normalize and store change events as ledger rows (immutable). - Compute risk score combining regression magnitude, active customer exposure, SLO violation probability, and cost delta. - Provide UI and API for filtering by customer cohort and region. - Automate alerting rules (Slack + console) for scores above threshold and create templated playbook cards for on-call owners.

Data sources & artifacts: - Confluence spec: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/MI/pages/Delta-Ledger-Spec (draft) - Drive folder (benchmarks & synthetic workloads): https://drive.company.com/teams/model-intel/Delta-Ledger - Nightly benchmark job: ENG/benchmarks#pr-842 (github) - Console mockups: https://figma.com/file/console-delta-ledger-mockup - Existing Watchtower project: PM-100999 (integration target)

Risks & trade-offs: - False positives if microbenchmarks not representative; mitigation: tiered thresholds + signal fusion. - Performance cost to run frequent probes; mitigation: adaptive sampling by customer exposure. - Schema complexity vs flexibility: ledger immutable rows simplify audit but require migration story for scoring changes. Decision: start immutable ledger v1 with explicit 'score_version' metadata.

Acceptance criteria: - End-to-end pipeline runs nightly and writes ledger rows for all tracked models. - Scoring function is configurable via SSM/feature flags. - Console displays last 30 events per model and links to playbook. - Integration test demonstrates a seeded latency regression and triggers Slack alert within 2 hours.

Stakeholders: Product: Maya Patel (owner), Eng: Rafael Ortega (assignee), Data Eng: Priya Singh, Observability: Jorge Martinez, Solutions Eng: Heather Li, Legal/Procurement reviewer: Anika Rao.

Notes: Aligns with enterprise ask from field (SE deck 2026-02) to be able to auto-detect vendor breakages and produce procurement-ready evidence. Plan to pilot with top 12 models + 5 enterprise customers for April release.
